title: Pure Runick
summary: Runick cards only, with generic hand traps and staples. Runick has no Main Deck monsters: every Runick Quick-Play Spell either disrupts the opponent and banishes from the top of their Deck, or Special Summons a Runick Fusion straight to the Extra Monster Zone at the cost of your next Battle Phase.

summary.title: Starters
points: Runick Tip searches any Runick card from the Deck and banishes 1 card from the top of the opponent's Deck, or Special Summons a Runick Fusion to the Extra Monster Zone.
Any Runick Quick-Play Spell can Special Summon Hugin the Runick Wings to the Extra Monster Zone, which discards 1 card to search Runick Fountain from the Deck.
Munin the Runick Wings discards 1 card on summon to search the Continuous Spell Runick Allure.
Geri the Runick Fangs recovers Runick Fountain or Runick Allure from the GY when Special Summoned from the Extra Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Any Two Runick Quick-Play Spells
steps: Activate a Runick Quick-Play Spell to Special Summon Hugin the Runick Wings to the Extra Monster Zone, and discard 1 card to search Runick Fountain.

Activate Runick Fountain, fire a second Runick Quick-Play Spell (such as Runick Tip or Runick Golden Droplet), and use Runick Fountain to shuffle the used Quick-Play Spells from your GY into the Deck and draw that many cards.
Pass turn with Runick Quick-Play Spells in hand, ready to activate directly from your hand on the opponent's turn while Runick Fountain is on the field.

summary.title: Runick Fountain & Deck-Out Engine
summary.text: Runick Fountain (Semi-Limited) is the heart of the deck: while it is in your Field Zone, you can activate Runick Quick-Play Spells from your hand during your opponent's turn, and once per turn after you activate a Runick Quick-Play Spell, you can place up to 3 Runick Quick-Play Spells from your GY on the bottom of your Deck to draw that many cards. Runick Allure banishes an extra card from the top of the opponent's Deck every time a Quick-Play Spell activates.

summary.title: Extra Deck Fusions
points: Sleipnir the Runick Mane banishes itself and a face-up monster the opponent controls until the End Phase on either Main Phase, and Special Summons a Runick Token whenever the opponent adds a card from the Deck to the hand outside the Draw Phase.
Hugin the Runick Wings banishes itself from the field instead whenever another card you control would be destroyed by card effect, shielding Runick Fountain.

Munin the Runick Wings banishes itself to negate an effect that targets a Runick card or Set card you control, while Geri the Runick Fangs destroys a card on the field when destroyed by battle and Freki the Runick Fangs recovers a Runick Quick-Play when destroyed.

summary.title: Quick-Play Disruption
points: Runick Flashing Fire destroys a Special Summoned monster and banishes 2 from their Deck; Runick Freezing Curses negates an Effect Monster and banishes 3.
Runick Destruction destroys a Spell/Trap and banishes 4; Runick Dispelling discards a random card after they search and banishes 2.
Runick Slumber protects a monster from destruction once and banishes 3; Runick Smiting Storm banishes up to the number of cards they control; Runick Golden Droplet makes them draw 1 to banish 4.
